description: Research-guided mathematical manuscript writing with mandatory attribution of known results, rigorous citation verification, reference-guided exposition, and LaTeX manuscript review.

defaultPrompt: Use Writee to turn my Researchee results into a rigorously cited mathematical paper in LaTeX.
Analyze the writing style of a paper I provide and draft my Introduction, with verified references.
Audit this mathematical manuscript for prior art, missing attribution, and citation accuracy.
interface.longDescription: Transform mathematical research into coherent, citation-audited LaTeX manuscripts. Detect and attribute previously known results even when proofs are independently reconstructed; adapt high-level exposition to reference papers; preserve mathematical integrity.

name: writee
